about: Release-policy template (W-42). release.sh policy sign fills policy_id, signed_at and expires_at, merges paths.json, and signs the result. allow names Tekton pipelines; anything not listed waits for the Owner. Every condition must hold for platform-api to approve a tier-C release without the Owner. trust_anchor_self_checked (Owner 2026-11-15: no second reader; the author proves a change to the judge with machine facts): a no_trust_anchor_change hit in a self_checked_repos repository is covered when the diff touches no owner_only path (paths.json) and the commit's CI succeeded; that CI runs the must-refuse sets, which live under the owner_only paths, and the decision snapshots; trust_anchor_ignore_tests leaves _test.go and testdata out of what counts as a trust-anchor hit, never out of owner_only. ddl_reversible (Owner 2026-11-15): a migration file under ddl_reversible_paths that is new in the diff and whose every statement is of a kind that cannot destroy rows is not a no_ddl refusal, and run_agentrt_migration may apply such files without the Owner once the source environment delivered the commit. apply (class 4): an apply_manifest plan is covered when every object is one of these kinds in these namespaces, already exists with an Apply entry of field_manager (so the same path at an earlier commit of main is the way back), and neither its path nor any object is excluded; everything else waits for the Owner. Owner 10-08: no rolling cap; reminders 14d, 3d and 1d before expiry.
